summary: P1 XSS hardening (httpOnly cookie + CSRF double-submit) end-to-end verification across backend + live browser. All 6 backend cookie/CSRF tests PASS (test_auth_cookies_csrf.py). Live browser flow on the preview URL: (1) POST /api/auth/login as founder@audinexa.com returns 200 with csrf_token in body + sets both Set-Cookie headers; (2) access_token cookie has httpOnly=True, secure=True, sameSite=Lax; (3) audinexa_csrf cookie has httpOnly=False (JS-readable), secure=True, sameSite=Lax; (4) localStorage.acs.token is NOT written on the new login (the key XSS hardening guarantee); (5) document.cookie from JS shows audinexa_csrf but NOT access_token (confirms HttpOnly is honoured by the browser); (6) /admin redirects to /admin/dashboard, /patients, /appointments, /settings (→/settings/profile) all load without 401 / login redirect; (7) fetch /api/auth/me with credentials:'include' (cookie-only, no Bearer) returns 200; (8) AppShell 'Sign out' button hits POST /api/auth/logout (200), both cookies removed by the browser, redirect to /login; (9) fetch /api/auth/me post-logout returns 401. Curl confirmation: Set-Cookie flags exactly as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: OK — set_auth_cookies() in /app/backend/utils/auth_cookies.py: httpOnly correctly toggled per cookie (true for access_token, false for audinexa_csrf), Secure+SameSite=Lax both set, Max-Age aligned with JWT TTL (7d), domain defaults to exact-host (apex-only) matching user's chosen option (a).

OK — CsrfMiddleware double-submit gate: state-change without X-CSRF-Token → 403 (verified by test_state_change_without_csrf_header_is_blocked); matching header bypasses (verified). Bearer-auth path is correctly exempt so the legacy pytest/API client suites keep working.

OK — Frontend AuthContext.js: live test confirmed NO write of localStorage.acs.token on a fresh login. document.cookie shows only audinexa_csrf (HttpOnly honoured). axios withCredentials:true working — /api/auth/me succeeds with cookie-only auth from the browser console.
OK — /api/auth/logout endpoint clears both cookies (browser shows neither cookie post-call), and the AppShell 'Sign out' control hits it correctly. Post-logout /auth/me returns 401 as expected.

Cosmetic (NOT a bug, pre-existing) — Console shows recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on the founder dashboard and 4 generic 404s on the /admin page load (likely missing background-data endpoints unrelated to auth). Auth flow itself is clean.

Note for prod cutover — On audinexa.com you'll want to either (a) leave AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN unset (exact-host only, the user's chosen default) OR (b) set AUTH_COOKIE_DOMAIN=audinexa.com (no leading dot) for apex-only. In the preview pod the cookies got Domain=careful-feedback.preview.emergentagent.com which is the correct exact-host behavior.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 cookie+CSRF tests pass; curl Set-Cookie flags verified)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (login → cookies set, no localStorage token, authenticated nav, fetch /me with cookies, logout clears cookies + /me=401)

context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 XSS hardening is fully verified in both pytest and live browser on the preview URL. Re-run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_auth_cookies_csrf.py -v` (6 tests, ~3s). Browser regression script lives inline in iteration_31 — check post-login Playwright cookies for httpOnly flag and `localStorage.getItem('acs.token')===null`. The logout button is `button:has-text('Sign out')` in the AppShell sidebar (no dedicated data-testid yet — consider adding `data-testid=appshell-logout` for stability). rca of the issue: No bugs surfaced. The httpOnly cookie + CSRF double-submit migration works end-to-end: backend sets the right flags, browser honours HttpOnly (JS cannot read access_token), CSRF middleware blocks header-less state-changes, axios withCredentials carries the cookie on subsequent requests, and logout cleanly invalidates the session client-side and server-side.
